verdict: This is a corrected candidate, not an acceptance. I read all six scans and their bands, and the line crops for s288. The primary has several transcription errors that the images confirm: לְזוֹל missing, זְכֹר instead of זֵכֶר, לְמִשְׁפָּט instead of לַמִּשְׁפָּט, בִּכְלֻלַת instead of בְּכַלַּת, כְּלוּלוֹתָהּ, שֶׁכִּלּוּ/רָגַע, אֲלֵיהֶם, וְחָשַׁקְתָּנוּ, קֵרַבְתָּ/נִשְׁכַּחְנוּ, יִכָּנֶה, אַהֲבַת הַבְּרִית, הארון, בְּמִשְׁפָּט, עֲלֵיהֶם בְּהַר, שׁוֹפָר, pointed shofar calls, several plene/defective spellings, and English 'of every moment', 'upon his children' and the silently corrected 'cogregation'. The blind reader's חזן שבת is wrong; the rubric reads אם שבת in Rashi script. The open items listed above need adjudication on the enlarged images.
